description: Design a fully branchless Base64 decoder where all conditional operations (error handling, padding detection, whitespace skipping) are expressed as predicated/conditional-move operations. Eliminates branch misprediction penalties that dominate small-input performance.
mathematical_formalization: Branch misprediction cost: ~15-20 cycles. For 32-byte input (8 iters), 1 mispredict costs 1.875 cycles/byte. Branchless C_cmov ~ 1 cycle. Savings when P(mispredict) > 1/15 ~ 7%.
analogical_connections: GPU shaders: all control flow is predicated for SIMT coherence
Real-time systems: WCET analysis requires branchless code
Branchless UTF-8 decoder by Chris Wellons
implementation_hypothesis: Express '+' vs '/' fixup as conditional add: fix = CMPEQ(input, 0x2f) AND -3; decoded += fix. Detect '=' with CMPEQ and zero, count at end. Zero branches in hot loop.
experiment_seed: Benchmark on short inputs (16-128 bytes). Compare branchless vs branching. Measure branch-misses counter. Target: 0 misses in decode loop.
